description: Social thread prospects (Reddit/X) where the brand's articles could earn a mention, with subreddit rules context, sorted by intent. Each thread also gives your next step as the dashboard's queue files it, nextMove: post, draft, opened, posted or skipped (opened: you opened your reply on the platform and it isn't on the thread yet), and stage: identified, reply_ready, opened, posted or skipped.

age.description: ranked: the best matches for your articles' keywords, of any age. new: threads posted in the last 48 hours on Reddit or 24 hours on X.

aiSources.description: Set true to list only the threads AI engines cite for your tracked questions (aiCited). Needs a product or service in Brand Control.

stage.description: Show one stage, as the Social tab's chips do: identified, reply_ready, opened (you opened your reply on the platform and it isn't on the thread yet), posted or skipped

status.description: Show one stored status: identified, reply_drafted (opened replies included), engaged (posted) or skipped

name: list_social_threads
